players.product: data-center communications infrastructure (design, build, maintenance) and generator enclosures used in data centers

quarterly_data.signal: IES Holdings 10-K: fiscal 2025 (ended September 30, 2025) revenue was $3,371,468 thousand; Communications revenue rose 46.9% to $1,140,640 thousand (33.8% of revenue), primarily on increased demand from data center customers, with operating income of $166,505 thousand; Infrastructure Solutions revenue rose to $498,724 thousand from $351,096 thousand, including Custom Engineered Solutions (such as data-center generator enclosures) of $400,462 thousand; Commercial & Industrial revenue rose 16.2% to $427,735 thousand with large data center projects; Residential fell to $1,304,369 thousand. No single customer exceeded 10% of consolidated revenues in fiscal 2025; one unnamed Residential customer accounted for 12.0% of consolidated revenues during the years ended September 30, 2024 and 2023, as the filing words it.

IES Holdings 10-K: backlog was at record levels heading into fiscal 2026, with data-center demand particularly strong, though labor availability and capacity could constrain growth; IES expects $1.4 billion of its September 30, 2025 backlog to become revenue in fiscal 2026 and the remaining $1.0 billion in fiscal 2027. Remaining performance obligations were $1,686,583 thousand, about $1,029,713 thousand of it expected within 12 months.
quarterly_data.figure: $1.4 billion of backlog in fiscal 2026, $1.0 billion in fiscal 2027

quarterly_data.signal: IES Holdings 10-K: fiscal 2025 capital expenditures of $67.3 million went to equipment that increases Infrastructure Solutions manufacturing capacity and to warehouse capacity and equipment for Communications, primarily in support of data center customers; IES expects fiscal 2026 capital expenditures of $110 million to $130 million. On September 8, 2025 it acquired an industrial fabrication business in Manitowoc, Wisconsin from Broadwind, forming Wisconsin Heavy Fabrication, which expands manufacturing capacity for Custom Engineered Solutions. Firm commitments to purchase materials such as copper and aluminum wire were $13.4 million at September 30, 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: Fiscal 2026 capex expected $110 million to $130 million
